how_to_use: For a move: play sky.body_animation on the user (from the user's Explorers of Sky folder; if the user's sprite is listed in species_overrides use that animation instead). Apply damage on that animation's hit_frame. Play effect_layers in order (layer 1-2 around the user, 3 travels/area, 4 on the target - best understanding of the game data). effect_attach_point says where the effect starts (Head/LeftHand/RightHand/Center from the Offsets sheet). A missing body animation in a species falls back to Attack. 'red' gives the Red Rescue Team equivalent.
